title: "1_external"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(brms, tidyverse, here, tidybayes, ggdist, HDInterval)
set.seed(12412)
```

```{r}
marker <- "permanent_scarring"
data <- read_csv(
  here("data", "model", "external", "input", paste0(marker, ".csv")),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
data %>% glimpse()
```

```{r}

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    y = as.integer(.data[[marker]]),
    world_region = fct_relevel(factor(world_region), "Africa")
  )

```

```{r}

cat("marker:", marker, "\n")
cat("N total rows      :", nrow(data), "\n")
cat("N non-missing y   :", sum(!is.na(data$y)), "\n")
cat("outcome balance   :\n"); print(table(data$y, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("predictor balance :\n"); print(table(data$violent_external, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("region counts     :\n"); print(table(data$world_region, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("year_scaled range :", range(data$year_scaled, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# 1. SEPARATION check — the critical one
cat("region x outcome (any 0 in the '1' column = separation):\n")
print(table(data$world_region, data$y))

# 2. the year skew, to confirm the -4.29 is a sparse ancient tail
cat("\nyear_scaled distribution:\n")
print(quantile(data$year_scaled, c(0, .05, .25, .5, .75, .95, 1), na.rm = TRUE))
cat("entries with year_scaled < -2 (ancient tail):", sum(data$year_scaled < -2, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r}

p_load(brms, tidyverse, here, tidybayes, ggdist, HDInterval)

f_base <- bf(
  permanent_scarring ~ 1 + violent_external + year_scaled + (1 | world_region)
)

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = Intercept), 
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b), 
  prior(exponential(1), class = sd) 
)

fit_base <- brm(
  formula = f_base,
  data    = data,
  family  = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior   = priors,
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, cores = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  seed = 1342, backend = "cmdstanr", silent = 2
)

```

This we need to save, both for multilevel and for regression coefficients. 

```{r}

summary(fit_base)

```

This we also need to save for each marker.

```{r}

pp_check(fit_base, ndraws = 100) 

```

Check regional: would be good to plot for each marker. 

```{r}

# check regional effects
ranef(fit_base)$world_region[,,"Intercept"] |> round(2)

```
This needs to be somehow formatted nicely together for all markers, but good. 

```{r}

h <- hypothesis(fit_base, "violent_external > 0", alpha = 0.025)
h

```
Now we need plotting with AME for the effect on the natural scale. 

```{r}

# --- AME: P(y=1 | conflict=1) - P(y=1 | conflict=0), probability scale ---
# grid: both conflict conditions, at mean year, across all observed regions
nd <- expand_grid(
  violent_external = c(0, 1),
  year_scaled      = 0,
  world_region     = unique(data$world_region)
)

ame_draws <- fit_base |>
  epred_draws(newdata = nd, re_formula = NA) |>     # <-- see note on re_formula
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(.draw, violent_external) |>
  summarise(p = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") |>  # average over regions within each draw
  pivot_wider(names_from = violent_external, values_from = p, names_prefix = "cond") |>
  mutate(ame = cond1 - cond0)

# summary consistent with hypothesis(): mean + 95% ETI (alpha=0.025 equivalent)
cat("AME (probability scale):\n")
cat("  mean    :", round(mean(ame_draws$ame), 3), "\n")
cat("  95% ETI :", round(quantile(ame_draws$ame, c(.025, .975)), 3), "\n")
cat("  P(>0)   :", round(mean(ame_draws$ame > 0), 3), "\n")

```

```{r}

p_ame <- ame_draws |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ame)) +
  stat_halfeye(.width = c(0.66, 0.95), point_interval = median_hdi,
               fill = "#C8839E", color = "black", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Average marginal effect (probability)", y = NULL,
       title = "Effect of violent external conflict on permanent scarring",
       subtitle = "Baseline model: AME at mean year, average region") +
  theme_bw()
p_ame

```
